text:
Maria: Quick sync — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy before we publish next Wed. I put updated slices in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/cardinal-landing (see pages 'Hero + CTAs' and 'Routing matrix').
Devin: On it. Do we have one hero line that works for all three modes or mode-specific headlines?
Maria: Prefer mode-specific headline variants but same subhead + CTA. Example: Hosted: 'Instant API access to production-quality LLMs' / Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput, dedicated GPUs' / Private: 'Your inference, in your network'. Short and punchy.
Sophia: Love those. Small note: Hosted hero should call out latency & pricing band. Can we add a subtle line: 'from $0.XX / 1k tokens' under the CTA?
Andrew: Agree on pricing cue but want to avoid exact numbers for initial hero. Maybe 'cost-optimized tiers' instead. We can surface pricing on the modal.
Karen: From an inbound routing POV — need clear CTA partitioning so leads go to correct flow. Hosted -> self-serve signup; Dedicated -> book capacity call; Private -> request demo / security questionnaire.
Maria: Routing matrix in figma has buttons wired: Set primary CTA per page + secondary 'Talk to sales' where applicable. We should also add UTM params for each CTA so marketing can attribute.
Devin: Will add UTM. Suggested pattern: `?utm_source=website&utm_campaign=cardinal_launch&utm_content=cta_hosted`
Sophia: Webinar integration: can we add a 'See benchmark results' CTA for Hosted that links to the benchmark blog + gated slides? That'll feed the webinar invite list.
Andrew: Good funnel — blog + gated slide deck -> webinar invite -> demo queue. Need copy for the benchmark summary card: 'Benchmarked across GPUs: latency, cost, tail P99. See methodology.'
Karen: For lead scoring, tag inbound leads by CTA clicked + webinar interest. Suggested tags: `hosted_selfserve`, `dedicated_capacity`, `private_security`. Also include a field `benchmark_interested` if they clicked slides.
Maria: @launch-bot can you confirm calendar: webinar on May 12 10am PT?
launch-bot: calendar.create_invite: Webinar "Serving LLMs at Scale" — May 12 10:00 PT, co-hosts: Sophia, Andrew. Link: https://meet.co/wv9x
Devin: One more micro copy ask — add microcopy under Dedicated CTA: 'Reserved capacity, SLA-backed performance.' Keep it single clause.
Sophia: I'll draft the benchmark blurb + bullets for methodology. Will include a short line: 'Key wins: 2-3x cost reduction on high-concurrency workloads.'
Andrew: For Private page, can we add compliance badges row (SOC2, ISO27001, VPC, HSM) with short tooltip copy? Engineering can provide cert links.
Karen: Sales flow: ensure the Dedicated CTA triggers a CRM stage 'MQL -> Capacity Request' and creates task for Solutions Eng. We'll need funnel playbook doc.
Maria: I'll iterate copy and push a new Figma pass tonight. Plan: copy freeze Tue EOD, dev handoff Wed morning. Can everyone review the new pass by Tue 12pm PT?
Devin: Review confirmed.
Sophia: Confirmed.
Andrew: Confirmed.
Karen: Confirmed.
Maria: Thanks team — will post updated wire and a short checklist (UTMs, CTAs, tags, cert links). :rocket:
